title: a member reports something, and the operator can take a photo down

criteria.text: A signed-in member sends a free-text report from an item or shop page
criteria.note: `ReportControl` on the Page and post cards, its entries labelled "Report this Page", "Report this Page's photo", "Report this post" (#938, 647eccb); `sendReportAction` refuses signed-out callers (#81, #82); #1184 added a third subject, a member's own post, to the same control (`subjectKind` `member_post`) [V reread 2026-11-06]. Checked: `[guards F058.1]` in `f058-criteria.test.tsx` [V]. Reviewed: #81, #82 carry no `Reviewed by:`; #938 does [V]. Shipped: deploy-health began 2026-09-16, after #81 and #82 merged on 14 Sep, so no run exists for them; #938 green [V]. Smoked: unknown. The last green run covering `page` is `smoke-live` 2026-11-01 (3df9260); #1169, #1172 and #1184 changed the Page's report entries after it, and no run has reached a signed-in screen since (11-02 red, 11-03 and 11-05 stalled at sign-in, fix #1190 merged 11-06) [V].

criteria.text: A report changes nothing visible to anyone, including the reported party
criteria.note: RETIRED. Overtaken by F078 criteria 2 and 3 and the 2026-10-11 courtesy-notice ruling in F078 `## Rulings`: a first report leaves the item up and sends a courtesy notice, a second hides it and the owner is told why (`create.test.ts`: "F078 criterion 3 amends F058 acceptance 2"). What still holds: the reporter is never named to the owner (`tests/report-privacy-db.test.ts`) [V]. The scenario still carries the old text; `sync-roadmap` amends it [V].

criteria.text: Only the operator sees or can invoke Remove; others rejected by the handler
criteria.note: `report.remove` and `report.reverse` refuse a member, an owner and an unset operator before the database; `/admin/reports` is 404 to others [V] reread 2026-11-06. The last green run covering `admin-reports` is `smoke-live` 2026-11-01 (3df9260); #1184 (2026-11-05) changed the review queue after it, and no run has reached a signed-in screen since (11-02 red, 11-03 and 11-05 stalled at sign-in, fix #1190 merged 11-06) [V].
